title: 第477章 请老祖出山第476章 天魔圣地
content_zh:
荒古神国。
北城。
小院中。
许小凡盘膝坐在树下修炼，依旧如往日般勤奋。
不远处。
许老祖躺在摇椅之上，眼睛微闭。
好不悠闲。
此时，许小凡周身大帝领域涌现。
随着修炼。
这片混沌世界，愈发凝实起来。
不过很快。
许小凡却被迫终止修炼。
旋即缓缓睁眼，叹了口气。
“随着突破大帝，我的神魔炼气诀也突破到了第六层中期巅峰。”
“只可惜这门功法突破到这个境界之后，竟只能依靠着混沌之气来修炼。”
“道祖前辈那阵法虽在源源不断抽取神魔之躯体内的混沌之气，可抽取的速度实在太慢，已经远远赶不上我修炼的速度了。”
想到这。
许小凡不由在脑海中问道：
“前辈，阵法改良的如何了？”
道祖：

“老夫知道你很急，但你先别急。”
“这修改阵法是个精细活，岂是短短几日就能成的？”
“放心，等老夫阵法修改完毕，必帮你把这神魔之躯内的混沌之气，都给吸空不可！”
神魔之躯：“......”
说罢。
道祖便再没了下文。
许小凡微微摇头，一个鲤鱼打挺，便从地上站了起来。
旋即他目光看向许老祖。
“老祖，来吧，我要炼体！”
许老祖睁开眼，看了许小凡一眼。
下一刻。
一股恐怖的威压降临。
轰！
在这股威压之下，许小凡直接跪了下来。
地面之上当即出现一处小坑。
与此同时。
许小凡无论肉身，还是神魂，都承受着一股极其恐怖的压力。
content_en:
The ancient divine kingdom.
Beicheng.
In the small courtyard.
Xu Xiaofan sat cross-legged under the tree to practice, still as diligent as ever.
Not far away.
Patriarch Xu lay on the rocking chair with his eyes slightly closed.
Very leisurely.
At this time, the Great Emperor Domain emerged around Xu Xiaofan.
With practice.
This chaotic world is becoming more solid.
But soon.
Xu Xiaofan was forced to stop practicing.
Then he slowly opened his eyes and sighed.
"With the breakthrough of the Great Emperor, my God and Demon Qi Refining Technique has also broken through to the peak of the mid-sixth level."
"It's a pity that after this skill breaks through to this level, it can only be practiced with the energy of chaos."
"Although Senior Dao Ancestor's formation is continuously extracting the energy of chaos from the body of gods and demons, the extraction speed is too slow and can no longer keep up with the speed of my cultivation."
Think of this.
Xu Xiaofan couldn't help but ask in his mind:
"Senior, how is the formation improved?"
Daozu:
"I know you are in a hurry, but please don't be anxious yet."
"Modifying the formation is a delicate job. How can it be done in just a few days?"
"Don't worry, after I finish modifying the formation, I will help you suck out all the energy of chaos in this body of gods and demons!"
Body of gods and demons: "..."
Say it.
Daozu has no more words.
Xu Xiaofan shook his head slightly and stood up from the ground.
Immediately he looked at Patriarch Xu.
"Ancestor, come on, I want to train my body!"
Ancestor Xu opened his eyes and glanced at Xu Xiaofan.
The next moment.
A terrifying pressure came.
boom!
Under this pressure, Xu Xiaofan knelt down directly.
A small pit immediately appeared on the ground.
at the same time.
Xu Xiaofan, both physically and mentally, was under an extremely terrifying pressure.
